observations: An L-shaped office desk with a cherry/wood-grain laminate top and black base/side panels.
Desk has caster wheels on at least one visible leg.
A cable-management grommet hole is visible on the desktop surface.
Edges and corners of the desktop show visible scuffs and wear in both photos.
Desk is sitting outdoors on wet, muddy pavement alongside other used furniture (sofas, a small cabinet) at what looks like an open-air secondhand market.
No brand name, logo, or model number visible anywhere on the desk.
No close-up of drawers, joints, underside, or legs is provided.
People and umbrellas in the background suggest a street-side furniture resale location, not a showroom.

claims.evidence: Subjective claim; photos only show exterior surface from a distance, no way to judge build quality remotely.
Photo 0 and photo 1 show visible scuffs/scratches on the desktop edges and the desk standing in mud/water on an open street, not a clean setting.

risks.risk: Structural integrity of joints/frame (wobble, cracks, broken welds) not visible from these angles.
risks.proof: A photo or short video of the desk being pushed/shaken, and a close-up of all leg/frame joints.
risks.if_unproven: priced as structurally unverified, i.e. at the low end for a used desk of this type

risks.risk: Drawer/compartment functionality (if any) is not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of drawer open/closed and a clip of it sliding.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if drawers may be stuck or missing hardware

risks.risk: Water/moisture damage risk since the desk sits directly on wet ground outdoors, which can warp laminate or swell MDF/particleboard edges.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the underside and all four edges/corners, especially near the base, showing no swelling or delamination.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if moisture damage is present

risks.risk: Caster wheels' condition and whether they lock/roll properly is unverified.
risks.proof: Short video of the desk being rolled on the wheels.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if wheels are non-functional

risks.risk: Surface scratches seen in photos may be deeper gouges or chips not clear from this resolution.
risks.proof: Close-up, well-lit photos of the scuffed areas on the desktop.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of all desktop edges and corners in good lighting.
Photo/video of any drawers opening and closing.
Short video of the desk being pushed to check wobble and caster rolling.
Close-up of the underside and legs near the base to check for water/moisture damage.
Photo of the desk in a dry, indoor setting if possible, to better assess true cleanliness and color.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as an L-shaped office desk by type, and though several condition claims are unverified or contradicted by visible wear and the wet outdoor setting, this is enough to price it at worst-case used condition rather than block on missing identity information.
